verdict.rationale: Fellow publishes a structured, per-endpoint API reference at developers.fellow.ai/reference, covering recordings, action items, note agenda writes, uploads and the authenticated user, plus an llms.txt. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or offers runnable or try-it examples, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404. missing for 10: evidence of an in-browser try-it/runnable request console, code samples per endpoint, a published OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration of interactivity.
